title: On the Unit Teissier Distribution: Properties, Estimation Procedures and Applications
summary: The Teissier distribution, originally proposed by Teissier [31], was designed to model mortality due to aging in domestic animals. More recently, Krishna et al. [19] introduced the Unit Teissier (UT) distribution on the interval (0, 1) through the transformation $X=e^{-Y}$, where $Y$ follows the Teissier distribution. In their work, the authors derived several fundamental properties of the UT distribution and investigated parameter estimation using maximum likelihood, least squares, weighted least squares and Bayesian methods.
